summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 30, 2026, reporting updated Phase 1b/2a RESOLVE trial data for EP-104GI in eosinophilic esophagitis. The highest dose cohort (Cohort 9) showed 66% (2 of 3) of patients maintaining clinical remission at 52 weeks, while Cohort 8b showed histologic improvement at 36 weeks. Across all cohorts, 9 of 14 patients (64%) remained in remission 52 weeks after a single administration. No treatment-related serious adverse events or corticosteroid-exposure events were observed. This is a routine clinical-update filing, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed.
